article_title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: Finland is closing all rail services to Sweden
A restored passenger service has reconnected northern Finland and Sweden after nearly 40 years
Sweden is replacing every railway track with a Russian-width track
A new airport has opened between Oulu and Haparanda
tasks.correct_answer: A restored passenger service has reconnected northern Finland and Sweden after nearly 40 years
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בחידוש קו הנוסעים בין אואולו שבהפינלנד להפרנדה שבשוודיה לאחר הפסקה של כמעט ארבעה עשורים.

tasks.prompt: Where did the inaugural train begin its journey?
options: Helsinki
Stockholm
The Finnish coastal city of Oulu
Portugal's Algarve
tasks.correct_answer: The Finnish coastal city of Oulu
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הרכבת החגיגית הראשונה יצאה מעט אחרי 05:00 מהעיר החופית אואולו שבפינלנד.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “inaugural” mean?
options: Delayed by technical problems
Travelling only at night
Crossing a national border
The first official service marking a new beginning
tasks.correct_answer: The first official service marking a new beginning
tasks.explanation_hebrew: inaugural מתאר אירוע ראשון ורשמי; כאן מדובר בנסיעה הראשונה של השירות המחודש.

tasks.prompt: How often is the new Oulu–Haparanda service scheduled to run?
options: Twice a day
Once a week
Every two hours through the night
Only during the summer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הקו החדש פועל פעמיים ביום, והנסיעה בין אואולו להפרנדה נמשכת כ־100 דקות.

tasks.prompt: Why must passengers transfer to another train at Haparanda to continue south?
options: The border is closed to Finnish passengers
Finland and most of Europe use different railway track widths
The Swedish train has no passenger seats
The route south is operated only by buses
tasks.correct_answer: Finland and most of Europe use different railway track widths
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פינלנד משתמשת במסילה רחבה יותר מהתקן האירופי, שריד מתקופתה בדוכסות הרוסית, ולכן נדרשת החלפת רכבת.

tasks.prompt: What does “holdover” mean when the article describes Finland's wider track gauge?
options: A station where passengers wait
A modern European safety rule
Something that remains from an earlier period
A ticket valid for two countries
tasks.correct_answer: Something that remains from an earlier period
tasks.explanation_hebrew: holdover הוא שריד מן העבר; רוחב המסילה הפיני נותר מתקופה היסטורית שבה פינלנד הייתה קשורה לאימפריה הרוסית.

tasks.prompt: Give two facts about the first train's route and reception.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים מדויקים על המסלול או על קבלת הפנים לנסיעה הראשונה.
expected_points: It left Oulu shortly after 05:00 local time
It crossed the Torne river into Sweden
Crowds at Haparanda waved Finnish and Swedish flags
The journey to Haparanda takes about 100 minutes

tasks.prompt: Summarise why the service stopped and why its return matters in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את סיבת ההפסקה, הבעיה הטכנית, השירות החדש והחשיבות האזורית או האירופית.
expected_points: The earlier service was suspended around the late 1980s and early 1990s
Low passenger numbers and different track gauges contributed to the suspension
The new twice-daily route reconnects northern Finland with Sweden
It improves longer rail journeys toward southern Europe and reflects cross-border cooperation

tasks.prompt: How could the new service help both local travellers and long-distance rail passengers?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר תועלת אחת לנוסעים מקומיים ותועלת אחת לרשת האירופית הרחבה.
expected_points: Local passengers gain a direct cross-border option between Oulu and Haparanda
Travellers can connect southward from Haparanda after changing trains
The link makes very long journeys between Lapland and southern Europe possible

tasks.prompt: Explain why railway standards and international cooperation are both important for cross-border train services.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין תאימות טכנית לבין תיאום מדיני ותפעולי, תוך שימוש בדוגמה מהכתבה.
expected_points: Different track widths can prevent the same train from continuing
Updating infrastructure or arranging transfers solves technical barriers
Operators and governments must coordinate timetables, borders and investment
The restored Finland–Sweden link demonstrates practical cooperation
